contractCorrections.correctAnalysis: Corrected on branch feat/publish-correct-analysis-contract: the previous entry named table:slabs (the V1 direct-patch path that the permission model revokes) with status BACKEND_CONTRACT_REQUIRED and classification SECURITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED. The corrected entry names the deployed rpc:correct_slab_identification, status READY, classification BROWSER_CUSTOMER_SAFE. Contract facts read from the migration and re-verified read-only against the production definition on 2026-08-04: 15-column whitelist (CORRECT_SLAB_IDENTIFICATION_FIELDS), self-owned-only FOR UPDATE row selection for every caller including administrators (cross-owner returns not_found), active-profile gate for non-admins, SOFT jsonb refusals ({ok:false,error} — not raised exceptions), success {ok:true,replayed,slab_id,changes} without the updated row, btrim/NULL-clearing semantics, ::integer year cast that raises on non-numeric input, optional trimmed idempotency key with per-(owner,key) advisory-lock serialization and idempotency_conflict on key reuse against a different slab, slab_correction_events + audit_log appends in the same transaction.
contractCorrections.startSlabAnalysis: Request type replaced with the real handler body read at supabase/functions/analyze-slab/index.ts: front_image_base64 + front_mime required, back_image_base64/back_mime optional and forwarded ONLY when both are present, variants[] {label,image_base64,mime} max 8. There is no slabId argument. Limits from src/server/analyze-slab/validate-images.ts: 15728640 bytes per image, 41943040 bytes aggregate, MIME jpeg/png/webp/heic/heif. The manifest separates an application-facing camelCase StartSlabAnalysisRequest from the snake_case StartSlabAnalysisWireRequest, with toStartSlabAnalysisWireRequest as the only sanctioned conversion. That serializer rejects blank and whitespace-only front, back and variant image data, rejects blank and whitespace-only variant labels with INVALID_VARIANT_LABEL, accepts exactly eight variants and rejects nine, emits both back keys or neither, never emits an empty variants array, emits only the exact wire keys, and mutates nothing it is given. Status is READY: the handler is merged (72e6e58) and deployed, and this corrected request/authorization contract was exercised against the live handler (401 unauthenticated, 400 MISSING_IMAGE for an authorized customer on an empty body, 403 ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE for a suspended customer).
contractCorrections.duplicateCertificationRace: The wrapper takes pg_advisory_xact_lock(918273645) — the same transaction-scoped lock canonical create_slab (20260833000000) uses — BEFORE its certification probe, so a concurrent intake cannot insert a matching normalized grader/certification between probe and insert. Without it the probe could miss and create_slab would raise an uncaught 23505 instead of returning result='duplicate_certification'.
contractCorrections.fieldEvidenceOwnership: Canonical link_ai_analysis_run applies its ai_field_evidence ownership check only to non-admins. Because this wrapper is self-owned-only, the check is meaningful for every caller and is applied unconditionally before anything is created (42501).

promotionProcess: 1. Create the review branch and open a DRAFT pull request.
2. Run clean backend installation, typecheck, lint, formatting and unit tests in pull-request CI.
3. Apply the proposed migration only to an isolated STAGING database. Never production.
4. Run the complete live integration suite (95 cases) with zero skips and zero retries.
5. Record the staging verification commit, timestamp and results here (liveVerificationState='passed-staging', stagingVerifiedAt).
6. Review and merge the pull request. Set mergeState='merged', mergeCommit, mergedMainCommit, mergedMigrationCount=68, mergedFinalMigration.
7. Deploy the merged migration through the controlled deployment process. Set deploymentState='deployed', deployedCommit, deployedAt.
8. Run the approved deployed verification subset against the deployed database.
9. Only then set saveConfirmedSlabFromAnalysis to READY, and startSlabAnalysis to READY only after its corrected request shape has been exercised against the deployed handler.
10. Regenerate the canonical frontend snapshot (bun scripts/build-contract-snapshot.mjs --mode canonical --frontend <path>) and re-reconcile the frontend claim map.
11. Connect the frontend call sites in a separate milestone.
rollback: Drop only public.save_confirmed_slab_from_analysis(uuid, jsonb, text, text) and revert contract metadata. The REVOKE/GRANT statements in the migration apply solely to that new function and disappear with it; no existing grant, table, policy or trigger is touched, and there is no data migration to reverse.

ownershipPolicy.administrators: An administrator may save only an analysis run they own. Saving another account's run is refused with 42501; no slab is created and the run stays unlinked.
ownershipPolicy.rationale: Canonical public.create_slab inserts owner_id = auth.uid() and accepts no owner argument, and the repository contains no owner-aware slab creation path (verified by repository-wide search). Allowing an admin to save another account's run could only create the card in the admin's inventory, so it is refused instead.
ownershipPolicy.statusGate: 'succeeded'/'needs_review' required of every caller; no administrator override.
ownershipPolicy.evidenceGate: ai_field_evidence rows for the run must all belong to the target owner; applied to every caller, including administrators.
ownershipPolicy.postCreateAssertion: The created slab's owner_id must equal v_target_owner or the whole transaction is rolled back (42501).
